name: Ollama | Private LLMs on CPU with Open WebUI and a Secured API
description: Run open LLMs on CPU: slim Ollama, token-gated API, Open WebUI chat
card_desc: Ollama: run open models like Llama, Qwen and Gemma on your own server. A slim CPU build tuned to Railway's vCPU quota, an API locked behind a Bearer token, and Open WebUI for chat.
